2608.09996.title: Energy and Performance Benchmarking of Deep Learning Models for Breast Cancer Detection
2608.09996.paper_summary: Recent advances in machine learning have greatly improved breast cancer detection, enabling more accurate and timely diagnosis. Deep learning (DL) models show strong potential for medical image analysis; however, as their architectural complexity increases, their environmental impacts are becoming a growing concern. In this paper, we present a comparative analysis of seven DL models for breast cancer detection on two medical datasets: Breast Ultrasound and BreakHis 400X. The evaluated architectures range from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and transformers to hybrid models. In addition to performance metrics, we assess CO2 emissions during both training and inference. Our results show that EfficientNet and ResNet consistently deliver strong performance, although with higher CO2 emissions. The selected transformers, such as DeiT-Tiny, perform competitively on both datasets, whereas DenseNet121 achieves lower accuracy. On the Breast Ultrasound Dataset, DeiT provides the most favourable balance between accuracy and energy consumption, whereas on the BreakHis dataset, the ViT and Swin models achieve the best results. Overall, our findings indicate that no single architecture category from the evaluated ones consistently dominates across the two selected datasets. Our results highlight the importance of jointly considering performance, emissions, and dataset characteristics when selecting models for medical applications.
2608.09996.paper_summary_zh: 最近在機器學習方面的進展大幅改善了乳腺癌的檢測，使得診斷更加準確和及時。深度學習（DL）模型在醫學影像分析中顯示出強大的潛力；然而，隨著其架構複雜性的增加，其環境影響也成為日益關注的問題。在本文中，我們對七種DL模型在兩個醫學數據集上的乳腺癌檢測進行了比較分析：乳腺超聲和BreakHis 400X。所評估的架構範圍從卷積神經網絡（CNNs）和Transformer到混合模型。除了性能指標外，我們還評估了訓練和推理過程中的二氧化碳排放。我們的結果顯示，EfficientNet和ResNet始終提供強勁的性能，儘管二氧化碳排放較高。所選的Transformer，如DeiT-Tiny，在兩個數據集上表現競爭力，而DenseNet121則達到較低的準確度。在乳腺超聲數據集中，DeiT提供了準確性和能耗之間最有利的平衡，而在BreakHis數據集中，ViT和Swin模型則取得了最佳結果。總體而言，我們的研究結果表明，所評估的架構類別中沒有一種在兩個選定數據集上始終佔據主導地位。我們的結果強調了在選擇醫療應用模型時，聯合考慮性能、排放和數據集特徵的重要性。
